scope: China patent and reported tooling/manufacturing activity

records.claim: CN115003190B is a granted Chinese invention patent in the Nyfasi hairbrush/applicator patent family.
limitations: Google Patents is not the official CNIPA legal-status register.
Current fee status, lapse/restoration and assignments require CNIPA verification.

records.claim: The translated Chinese patent record names Youmna Mouhamad as inventor and displays the applicant/assignee as Mianna Nature Ltd.
limitations: Confirm the original Chinese applicant name and transliteration in CNIPA.
Confirm the chain of title to MYANA NATURALS LIMITED from official assignment records.

records.claim: A 15 October 2025 profile reports that Youmna Mouhamad travelled to China in 2024 to initiate industrial mould manufacture and initial production.
limitations: No factory, supplier, city or province is identified.
No purchase order, tooling agreement, invoice, shipping document or primary company confirmation has been inspected.
The report does not establish current production location or ongoing supplier relationship.

records.claim: The same article reports an industrial mould estimate of EUR 150000-200000 and a EUR 50000 grant from the Agence Nationale pour la Recherche et le Développement.
limitations: The article does not reconcile the difference between the reported mould estimate and grant amount.
Grant award documentation and expenditure schedule have not been independently inspected.

records.claim: The article reports sales in eleven countries at the time of publication.
limitations: No country-level sales, distributor, retail or shipment evidence has been inspected.

records.claim: An 8 October 2025 article reports that a UK government grant helped Nyfasi acquire a manufacturing mould.
limitations: The article does not name the grant programme, award amount or grant agreement.
It does not independently identify the toolmaker or factory.
It is unclear whether this is the same funding reported in the 15 October 2025 profile or a separate award.

records.claim: A 15 October 2025 article attributes a EUR 50000 grant to the Agence Nationale pour la Recherche et le Développement in connection with China mould manufacture and initial production.
limitations: A separate 8 October article refers to a UK government grant for mould acquisition; whether the awards are distinct is unresolved.
The grant award letter, funder identity, eligible expenditure and payment records have not been inspected.

records.claim: The Royal Academy of Engineering identifies Dr Youmna Mouhamad as Nyfasi founder and describes the Deluxe Detangler as patented technology combining treatment application and detangling.
limitations: This does not independently verify the China factory, tooling supplier, current production or patent legal status.

unverified_questions: Chinese manufacturer legal name and registered address
Physical mould owner and right to retrieve or transfer tooling
Tooling design and CAD file ownership
Manufacturing agreement, exclusivity and subcontracting terms
Resin grade, colourants, material declarations and quality controls
First-article inspection, dimensional reports and production acceptance
Batch quantities, shipments and present manufacturing location
CNIPA current patent legal events and applicant/assignee chain of title
Whether the UK government mould grant and the reported EUR 50000 ANR&D grant are separate awards, complementary funding or inconsistent descriptions of one award.

cad_parameter_provenance.PATENT_DISCLOSED: Explicitly stated in patent text; not automatically a retail measurement.
cad_parameter_provenance.MEASURED: Measured from an authorised physical sample with method and uncertainty recorded.
cad_parameter_provenance.IMAGE_ESTIMATED: Estimated from published imagery; record calibration and confidence.
cad_parameter_provenance.ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Chosen to make a model solvable; not asserted as product truth.
cad_parameter_provenance.SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED: Supported by authorised tooling or manufacturing documentation.

boundary: Desk research only. Not legal advice, a supplier audit, manufacturing specification, patent validity opinion or freedom-to-operate assessment.
